title: Patch notes: the base, less rubber-banding, and fixes
subtitle: FANGS Community Edition · 17 October 2026, evening
intro: A follow-up to this morning’s Community Patch: the base change from the community’s list, smoother movement in big fights, a new patch notes tab, and three hero fixes.
To get it: start the game through the launcher as usual; it updates itself.

sections.name: Highlights
items: No more running back into your base: once you leave it, you can’t walk back in until you die or the round ends, like in the old version.
Less rubber-banding: the game servers now send updates twice as often. In our tests, players were snapped back about half as often in big team fights, and Tufts less than half as often while dashing.
PATCH NOTES tab in the main menu, where you’re reading this.
Astrada’s cage in team colours, and Zoey sees her own ult’s landing again.

sections.name: General
items: The base: at spawn you’re protected inside your base, as before. The moment you step out, the protection ends and the way back in is blocked until you die or the round ends.
Smoother movement: the servers send updates 60 times a second instead of 30, so your game and the server disagree less about where everyone is.
PATCH NOTES: every update’s notes are in the main menu. After an update, the newest notes open once by themselves.

sections.name: Heroes
heroes: Flame Cage: your own cage and your teammates’ cages are yellow-orange, an enemy’s cage is red, so you can tell them apart at a glance.

Wing Dive (Space): less rubber-banding while dashing. Your game and the server now line up the dash better: in our lag tests, Tufts was snapped back less than half as often. Same distance, speed, slide and hit.
Ult: the Zoey player now sees the landing burst too (it only showed on other players’ screens, on every skin).

sections.name: Coming next
items: Reconnecting to a custom game after a crash or disconnect.
Training: stay in the augment phase as long as you like and start the round with F6.
Rowan’s new augment Burning Harvest, and Ishir’s ult showing the health the enemy is about to lose.

outro: Thanks for all the reports! Keep them coming.
